verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official Python SDK with a quick-start, a reference documenting sync and async clients, a public GitHub repo, and `pip install tavily-python`. Its methods cover search, extract, crawl, map, research, and RAG helpers. An official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK is also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, and evidence that the JS SDK covers crawl/map/research (its docs mention only search and extract).
